Surveillance… Health minister Dr Kalumbi Shangula today told New Era that Namibia has standing protocols in dealing with new diseases or health emergencies. He said this in reference to the human metapneumovirus that has been detected in China.

nodes.text: Available information indicate that the flu-like virus similar to the novel coronavirus has also been detected in India with five cases reported by the health officials.
